🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Ever wonder why ChatGPT forgets what you said 20 minutes ago?

Here is how LLM memory actually works:
🔹 LLMs store zero memory between turns.
🔹 Every response re-reads your previous messages in a 'context window'.
🔹 Once that window fills, older tokens are silently discarded!
